skills.name: remesso
skills.description: Send, receive and schedule stablecoin payments on Celo as an agent: be paid by a schedule, ask to be paid, commit a wallet to paying on a schedule, or bring a payment forward.

skills.name: remesso-x402
skills.description: Pay Remesso's paid HTTP services on Celo mainnet over x402 v2 — in USA₮ by default (USDC and USD₮ also accepted), gasless for the payer. Use it to buy live NGN rates or to bring a scheduled stablecoin payment forward.
